notes.title: v1.03 update!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
Over the past week, we've tried to implement as many things as possible for the best feel of the game. We hope that this update will make your experience of the game better!

Big things:

 Added damage to monsters when kicking them
https://i.ibb.co/TvRj60X/Kill-By-Foot.gif


 Fixed Berserk (big monster) getting stuck in passageways, now you can't hide from him there
https://i.ibb.co/n76W6rh/Berserker.gif


 Added map for easy and normal difficulty
https://i.ibb.co/kQwCwyM/Map.png

 Increased the distinction between difficulties and added a feature to enter your syd if you want to replay a level or speed through it
https://i.ibb.co/YPDfLDp/New-Difficulty-Overlay.png


 Improved visibility of rooms with generators through floor markings
https://i.ibb.co/Y3p7qSd/Marks-For-Generator-Room.png


 And added Steam achievements!
https://i.ibb.co/ScXCGSz/Achievements.png



Things are smaller:

 Added light indication for check panels in experiment rooms 
 Moved the toilet in the smallest corridor so that you won't get stuck in it
 Adjusted monster death animations
 Increase the frequency of background music playing and increase its default volume
 Corrected blackouts in some rooms
 Corrected colliders of some furniture
 Fixed a bug where you could use 1 item multiple times
 Fixed a bug where all NPCs were dead when loading a save


Balance:

 Slightly reduced the total number of items dropped 
 Reduced the number of items dropped on Hard difficulty
 Revolver dropout increased slightly
 Reduced increase in hunger when running



Well, good luck finding you a shotgun, and we'll go get some rest!

Regards, 
ValiantLight team

notes.title: Thank you and the announcement of the v1.03 update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
With the release of Sporeborn Dark, we have gained a lot of valuable experience. It has not been an easy journey, the results of which we are now absorbing to become better! 
This has only been possible because of you, your support and feedback from you, for which thank you so much!
It's been an interesting few days since release, we've tried to release critical patches as quickly as possible that improve the game experience by fixing some unpleasant issues and adding features that we didn't have time to release in time for the release.

With this post, we - the ValiantLight team, wanted to thank you all once again and announce an update, in which we will also provide fixes for some unpleasant moments and add a few features. We are going to release this update at the end of this week, if all goes well :)

Here's a quick summary of what's coming:

 - Addition of a map whose mechanics will be different from the difficulty selected
 - Adding steam achievements to the game
 - Improving the balance of the game on different difficulties
 - Fixing Berserk (a big monster), his animations and his getting stuck in passages
 - Fixing several unpleasant bugs

notes.title: v1.02 update
notes.notes:
A feature that we didn't have time to add in time for release, but is now available:
You can now select the difficulty level when starting the map
It differs in the size of the map and accordingly the number of monsters, items and generators on it, as well as the number of inventory slots. 
We hope that the ability to choose the difficulty will improve your gaming experience!

notes.title: Release announcement!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
Yes, Sporeborn Dark is releasing on September 19!
Thank you for staying with us throughout this year of development.
We’re excited to share some of the latest updates and improvements we’ve made in Sporeborn Dark.

Big changes:


 Improved character and monster animations. Movements are now smoother and more realistic, enhancing the overall experience.
https://i.ibb.co/mzn8VhL/GIF-03-09-2024-16-00-15.gif

 Added new rooms with visual storytelling elements. Items are arranged in a way that lets players imagine what happened there.
https://i.ibb.co/HqPbvCt/2024-09-03-160955.png

 Additional entities have been added to enhance storytelling.



Polishing and Visual Enhancements:

 Improved visibility of crushable bodies.
 Added variety to crushed bodies for a more immersive environment.
 Detailed work on furniture placement.
 Enhanced shadows and light representation on objects.
 Adjustments to the game flow, including the beginning and ending sequences.
 Game menu redesign with additional windows to improve user experience.
 Fixed a bug related to save file deletion.
 Overall game balance and difficulty adjustments.


We continue to polish and improve certain aspects of the game, and we're just a little bit away from release!

Now is a great time to add Sporeborn Dark to your wishlist so you don't miss out on that day:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2601640/Sporeborn_Dark/
